summary: This is a configuration file for a slide presentation (likely Pandoc or Reveal.js based). The front matter (lines 1-7) sets up metadata for the presentation, including a title and styling for the title slide with a background image. The rest of the file defines three slide sections marked by heading tags.

explanations.3: This key tells the presentation tool to apply specific styling attributes only to the title slide (the first one).
explanations.4: This specifies the file path to the background image that should appear behind the title slide.
explanations.5: This makes the background image stretch to fill the entire slide area without distortion.
explanations.6: This sets how transparent the background image should be — 0.9 means it's 90% opaque, letting a bit of whatever's behind it show through.
